notes: EVERY CLAN FOR ITSELF: WAR! skirmishes go wide — up to nine rival clans in a free-for-all on fields up to 4800 X 3600, XP that scales with the fight, a buildable BIT MINER for the long wars, retaliation targeting and drag-built walls. Super Buddy Run's tunnel and flying bugs bite again and mobile gets a FIRE throw; Mordor foes drop power-ups; Super Buddy Cart calms down and dresses up; and the old drag touch scheme is gone — joystick only.
